column2: Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here, a short walk. Flaa Heet's village lies south-west, a much longer way. The walled part of Lilmoth, which the map calls Lolmoth, lies west-north-west, further still.
Wild leeks grow a few paces north-west of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, a few paces south. A poison bloom grows east-south-east, about thirty paces off.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. They still carry their weapons and purses.
I gather leeks. That is all I do here.
